comment: Every user-visible string, once, for every shell. The core speaks codes; the shells speak these words. Tools/strings/strings.py writes the Apple String Catalog from it (strings.xml and .resw join with their shells). Keys are dotted lower case; an 'error.<code>' key is the words for a core error code. British spelling.

address.label.note: Accessibility label of the address field.

address.secure.note: Accessibility label of the padlock shown for an https page.

address.insecure.note: Accessibility label of the warning shown for an http page.

toolbar.open_location.note: Command (Command-L on a Mac): put the keyboard in the address field with the whole address selected.

tabs.list.note: Accessibility label of the strip of the window's tabs.

tabs.untitled.note: The name the strip gives a tab that has no page yet.

tabs.new.note: Button at the end of the strip of tabs, and command (Command-T on a Mac): open an empty tab.

tabs.close.note: Button on a tab in the strip, and command (Command-W on a Mac): close the tab.

suggestions.list.note: Accessibility label of the list of places offered under the address field as it is typed in.

zoom.open.note: Label of the button, beside the tabs, that opens the zoom bar.

zoom.in.note: Button in the zoom bar, and the command (Command-plus on a Mac): make the page bigger.

zoom.out.note: Button in the zoom bar, and the command (Command-minus on a Mac): make the page smaller.

zoom.reset.note: Accessibility label of the zoom bar's level, which puts the page back to 100% when pressed; and the command (Command-0 on a Mac).

zoom.level.note: The zoom bar's level, in per cent. %ld is the number; %% is a per cent sign.

zoom.done.note: Button that closes the zoom bar.

downloads.title.note: Title of the list of downloads, and the name of its half of the switch beside History.

downloads.empty.en: Files you download will be listed here.
downloads.empty.note: Shown in the Downloads list when nothing has been downloaded.

downloads.clear.note: Button in the Downloads list that takes every download off the list. The files stay where they are.

downloads.done.note: Button that closes the Downloads list.

downloads.stop.note: Accessibility label of the button beside a download that is still coming, which stops it.

downloads.forget.note: Accessibility label of the button beside a download that has ended, which takes it off the list. The file stays.

downloads.older.note: Button at the end of the Downloads list that shows the next, older page of downloads.

downloads.coming.note: Under a download that is still coming, when its size is known: how much has arrived, and how much there is. Both are sizes with their units, such as “1.2 MB”.

downloads.coming_so_far.note: Under a download that is still coming, when its size is not known: how much has arrived, as a size with its unit.

downloads.active.note: Accessibility value of the History and Downloads button while a download is coming.

prompt.permission.note: The sentence in the bar a tab shows when a page asks to use something of the device's. %1$@ is the site, as the address field shows it; %2$@ is what it wants: one or more of the prompt.kind strings, joined as a list by the system (in English: “your camera and your microphone”).

prompt.says.note: The first line of the bar a tab shows when a page says something or asks (alert, confirm, prompt). %@ is the site, as the address field shows it; the page's own words follow on the next lines.

prompt.ok.note: Button in the bar that shows what a page says or asks: accepts it.

prompt.cancel.note: Button in the bar that shows what a page asks: refuses it.

prompt.silence.note: Button in the bar that shows what a page says, from the page's second message on: this page is shown no more messages until another page loads.

prompt.answer.note: Accessibility label of the field in the bar where a page asks for a line of text.

prompt.download.note: The sentence in the bar a tab shows when a page starts a download and its site was not yet allowed to. %1$@ is the site, as the address field shows it; %2$@ is the name the file would be saved under, in quotation marks so that where it begins and ends can be seen.

prompt.kind.camera.note: What a page asks to use, in the prompt.permission sentence.

prompt.kind.microphone.note: What a page asks to use, in the prompt.permission sentence.

prompt.kind.location.note: What a page asks to use, in the prompt.permission sentence: where the device is.

prompt.allow.note: Button in a tab's prompt: lets the site use what it asked for, now and when it asks again.

prompt.refuse.note: Button in a tab's prompt: refuses what the page asked for, this time.

permissions.title.note: Title of the list of sites that were allowed to download, or to use the camera, the microphone or the location, and the name of its part of the switch beside History and Downloads.

permissions.empty.en: Sites you allow to download, or to use your camera, microphone or location, will be listed here.
permissions.empty.note: Shown in the Permissions list when no site was allowed anything.

permissions.clear.note: Button in the Permissions list that takes back what every site was allowed. Each will ask again.

permissions.done.note: Button that closes the Permissions list.

permissions.forget.note: Accessibility label of the button beside a site in the Permissions list, which takes back what it was allowed. The site will ask again.

permissions.kind.camera.note: What a site was allowed to use, under its name in the Permissions list. Several are joined as a list by the system.

permissions.kind.microphone.note: What a site was allowed to use, under its name in the Permissions list.

permissions.kind.location.note: What a site was allowed to use, under its name in the Permissions list: where the device is.

permissions.kind.downloads.note: What a site was allowed to do, under its name in the Permissions list: download files without asking each time.

find.open.note: Label of the button, beside the tabs, that opens the find bar; and the command (Command-F on a Mac).

find.field.note: Placeholder and accessibility label of the find bar's field.

find.previous.note: Button in the find bar: go to the match before.

find.next.note: Button in the find bar: go to the next match.

find.done.note: Button that closes the find bar.

find.none.note: Shown in the find bar when the text is not on the page.

find.count.note: Shown in the find bar where the engine counts: which match is shown, and how many there are. First %ld is the match's number, second the total.

history.open.note: Label of the button, beside the tabs, that opens the lists of pages visited and of files downloaded.

history.title.note: Title of the list of pages visited.

history.done.note: Button that closes the History list.

history.search.note: Placeholder and accessibility label of the field for finding a visit by words of its title or address.

history.empty.en: Pages you visit will be listed here.
history.empty.note: Shown in the History list when nothing has been visited yet.

history.none_found.note: Shown in the History list when the words typed find no visit.

history.forget.note: Accessibility label of the button beside a visit that removes it from history.

history.older.note: Button at the end of the History list that shows the next, older page of visits.

history.clear.note: Button in the History list that asks which visits to forget.

history.clear.title.note: Question asked by the Clear button of the History list, above the choices.

history.clear.detail.en: Visits that are forgotten can’t be brought back.
history.clear.detail.note: Under the question of which visits to forget.

history.clear.hour.note: Choice: forget the visits of the last hour.

history.clear.today.note: Choice: forget the visits since midnight.

history.clear.cancel.note: Choice: leave history as it is.

tab.empty.title.note: Heading of a tab that has no page yet.

tab.empty.hint.en: Type an address or a search above.
tab.empty.hint.note: Hint under the heading of an empty tab.

error.title.note: Heading shown over a page that failed to load.

error.retry.note: Button on the failed-page view: reload.

error.net.offline.en: You’re not connected to the internet.

error.net.dns.en: The site’s address couldn’t be found.

error.net.connect.note: A load failed: connection refused or lost.

error.net.timeout.en: The site took too long to answer.

error.net.tls.en: A secure connection to the site couldn’t be made.
error.net.tls.note: A load failed: TLS or certificate problem.

error.net.failed.en: Something went wrong while loading the page.
error.net.failed.note: A load failed for a reason without words of its own.

error.page.renderer_gone.note: The process drawing the page died.

error.download.cancelled.note: Under a download that was stopped.

error.download.network.note: Under a download that failed because of the network.

error.download.disk.note: Under a download that failed because its file could not be written.

error.download.interrupted.en: WebTiger was closed before it finished.
error.download.interrupted.note: Under a download that was still coming when the app ended.

error.download.failed.note: Under a download that failed for a reason this build has no words for.

error.engine.no_profiles.en: The web engine on this device can’t keep each Space’s logins separate. Update Android System WebView and try again.
error.engine.no_profiles.note: Android: the System WebView is too old to give each login set a profile of its own.

error.engine.no_private.en: Private windows aren’t available on this device yet.
error.engine.no_private.note: The engine cannot make a login set that is kept in memory only.

error.engine.unavailable.note: The web engine the tab asked for is not installed.

catalogue.title.note: Title of the design catalogue: a screen for designers that shows every design token and every state of the window.

catalogue.colours.note: Design catalogue: heading of the colour tokens.

catalogue.space.note: Design catalogue: heading of the spacing tokens.

catalogue.radius.note: Design catalogue: heading of the corner-radius tokens.

catalogue.size.note: Design catalogue: heading of the size tokens.

catalogue.states.note: Design catalogue: heading of the browser window's states.

catalogue.state.empty.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.loading.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.secure.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.insecure.en: A page that is not secure
catalogue.state.insecure.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.long.en: An address too long for its field
catalogue.state.long.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.failed.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.tabs.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.history.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.suggestions.en: Places offered as an address is typed
catalogue.state.suggestions.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.zoom.en: The zoom bar, on a page made bigger
catalogue.state.zoom.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.downloads_list.note: Design catalogue: a state of the Downloads list.

catalogue.state.downloads_empty.note: Design catalogue: a state of the Downloads list.

catalogue.state.prompt_alert.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.prompt_confirm.en: A page asks yes or no, not for the first time
catalogue.state.prompt_confirm.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.prompt_text.en: A page asks for a word
catalogue.state.prompt_text.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.prompt_download.en: A page asks to download a file
catalogue.state.prompt_download.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.prompt.en: A page asks to use the camera and the microphone
catalogue.state.prompt.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.permissions_list.note: Design catalogue: a state of the Permissions list.

catalogue.state.permissions_empty.note: Design catalogue: a state of the Permissions list.

catalogue.state.find.en: Find on the page, with a count
catalogue.state.find.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.find_none.en: Find on the page, not found
catalogue.state.find_none.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.history_list.note: Design catalogue: the History list with visits in it.

catalogue.state.history_empty.note: Design catalogue: the History list before anything has been visited.

catalogue.state.history_none_found.note: Design catalogue: the History list when the words typed find nothing.

catalogue.start_failed.note: Design catalogue: heading of what is shown instead of a window when the core refuses to start.

error.start.title.note: Heading when the core refused to start.

error.start.detail.note: Shown under the start failure heading. %@ is a code such as store.open.
